transcript: Today is June 18th, and you are listening to Transport Topics. I'm Esmeralda Leon. Is the problem of fraudulent insurance settlements getting worse or better? The threat to businesses has increased as those implicated face challenges about safety and insurance rates. Representative Peter Defazio says he is well aware that being stuck in traffic is bad for business. For that reason, he wants to remind the country that his new highway bill is designed to help everyone spend less time in traffic. Defazio Chairman of the U.S. House Transportation Committee is the author of a comprehensive five-year, $547 billion highway bill that he says would be the largest ever single investment in surface transportation infrastructure. He said, quote, people are pretty tired of congestion. They're pretty tired of repair costs because of potholes. They're tired of detours, end quote. JK Moving Services this week increased annual guaranteed income for experienced over-the-road drivers to a minimum of $100,000. Last week, paper transport announced its biggest-ever pay raise, and Averit Express announced a limited-time $5,000 sign-on bonus for qualified regional truckload drivers. That's all for today. Remember, for all the latest trucking and transportation news, go to the experts at TTNews.com.
